LanguageData.BOR_Pax.label: pax
LanguageData.BOR_Pax.description:
A "miracle drug" in all but name, Pax renders the user incapable of becoming ill or suffering from the most negative effects of age.
There have been wars fought over doses of Pax by 'lesser cultures', primarily for the amusement of the Tenebral Dominion.
